parts.t: Browse every townhome and townhouse for sale in Langley City and the Township of Langley below, at any price, and contact Jared today if you have questions.
Here are the townhomes for sale across the City of Langley and the Township of Langley, at any price. If a detached house is out of reach, a townhome is worth a look.
You'll find townhomes in both the Township and Langley City. The Township plans each growing area through its
community and neighbourhood plans page

, and those plans say where townhouses can go. In June 2026 it rewrote the Willoughby plans, folding five older neighbourhood plans into one corridor plan along 200 Street. Yorkson, Smith and Williams kept their own plans.
In Langley City, the
Official Community Plan

puts townhomes, duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes along future frequent bus routes on 200 Street and 208 Street, and in parts south of the Nicomekl River. That area is called Ground-Oriented Residential, and it's capped at about 1.2 times the lot area in floor space.
The gap is real. FVREB's Langley townhouse benchmark sits hundreds of thousands of dollars below the detached benchmark, and for many buyers that difference is the whole decision.
See the latest Langley market numbers
I grew up in Langley, and my advice is simple: tour a few complexes before you decide a townhome is or isn't for you. They vary more than you'd think.

blocks.text: What to compare when you tour

parts.t: Parking.
Double garage, tandem garage, or single plus driveway. Ask where visitors park, too.
Layout.
Count the stairs. A main-floor bedroom matters to some buyers.
Outdoor space.
Fenced yard, patio, or deck only.
Warranty.
Ask if any home warranty coverage is left.
Bylaws.
Pets, parking rules, and what you can change outside your unit.
The
Surrey Langley SkyTrain

extension will end at Langley City Centre Station near 203 Street and Industrial Avenue, with another stop at Willowbrook, 196 Street and Fraser Highway. The Province says the average trip from Langley City Centre to King George Station will be 22 minutes. If you commute toward Surrey or Vancouver, it's worth asking how far a complex is from those two stops.
Every townhouse complex is run by a strata corporation. Under B.C. rules, any strata with five or more lots has to get a
depreciation report
every five years, so ask for the latest one.
Also ask for the
Form B
. It shows the monthly fee, any special levies already approved, and summaries of the strata's insurance. I read these with you line by line before you commit.
FVREB reports the City and the Township as one Langley area and publishes a townhouse benchmark, median sale price, sales and active listings every month. Source: FVREB.

Langley School District (SD35)

school family groups

Where does Langley City plan new townhomes?
Along future frequent bus routes on 200 Street and 208 Street, and in select areas south of the Nicomekl River in the Ground-Oriented Residential area.
How much less is a Langley townhome than a house?
FVREB's Langley townhouse benchmark sits well below the detached benchmark. Compare the
current Langley benchmarks
Do townhouse complexes need a depreciation report?
Yes, if the strata has five or more lots. B.C. requires one every five years.
Does this page include Langley City?
Yes. It covers townhomes in both the City of Langley and the Township of Langley.
